title: 開いたアンダーカウンター食器洗浄機
description: 食堂や小さな厨房のカウンター下へ置く食器洗浄機外観。実際に開いた洗浄室、水平に開いた扉と洗剤入れ、少し引き出したワイヤー状ラックと支持ローラー、内部噴射アーム、排水口、裏の接続口・収納ホースを造形。カウンター・食器は含まず、扉とラックは固定姿勢です。洗浄・通水・電装機能は実装していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.616 × 0.821 × 1.283 m、20,008三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An undercounter-dishwasher appearance prop for cafeterias and small kitchens. It has a genuinely open chamber, horizontal open door/dispenser, partly withdrawn wire-like rack on support rollers, interior spray arm, drain opening, rear connections and parked hoses. Counter and dishes are absent; door and rack remain in one fixed pose. Washing, plumbing and electrical functions are not implemented. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.616 × 0.821 × 1.283 m; 20,008 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
